slides: The truth about why rejection sticks
No doesn't mean you're not good enough It means they don't know you yet
When someone says no to you
Your instinct is to agree with them
To believe they're right about who you are
When really they just said no to a stranger
You're believing the wrong person about yourself
They don't know you yet Ask again Follow for the one rule that changes it
caption:
Your biggest enemy isn't hearing no. It's your mindset believing it. Most men internalize rejection and build their whole identity around that one no.

What you're really hearing is no from a stranger who doesn't know you yet.

They didn't say no to you. They said no to the version of you they met for three seconds.

Ask again.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
